title: Big Fish in Small Ponds: Human Capital Migration and the Rise of Boutique Banks
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. Banker-bank-year regressions relate exits to boutique banks to bankers' log past deal counts (continuous) with person, bank and year FE (Tables 2-4). Bank-industry-year regressions use continuous non-M&A spillover measures (Tables 5, 7) and JOBS Act exposure x Post, a single 2012 date with continuous exposure (Table 6). Table 8 is deal-level.
